plot: In the uproarious comedy Comedy Gold, ordinary life becomes extraordinarily funny when everything that can go wrong does go wrong. Following a lovable cast of misfits as they navigate through increasingly ridiculous situations, this film delivers non-stop laughs and heartwarming moments.
